reads.why: Six rows the runner could not reach were deliberately left alone rather than half-read: all six were re-read live by two other channels earlier the same day — sess-8dffa7e8's automated 09:59Z pass, sess-545688f3's 10:0xZ direct PDP reads, and (for the four With Clarity rows plus these two Cartier rows) sess-3020df54's 10:26Z-10:39Z second-channel corroboration in data/session-3020df54/blocked-reread-2026-10-23.json, which found 7/7 exact matches and 0 drift. Re-fetching them here would add a third copy of the same numbers without adding a new fact, and the With Clarity product JSON responses are hundreds of variants wide, so they were skipped rather than truncated. Their stored values therefore rest on the earlier 2026-10-23 reads, and the site says so per row. — recorded so the pass reports its own gaps instead of implying full coverage.
